repo_prior_art.cite: none; the Stat catalogue has no RMST/censoring-endpoint entry

published_prior_art.cite: westling2024inference: cross-fitted causal survival/RMST inference requires positive-follow-up regularity and high-level nuisance conditions; tian2020endpoint: endpoint RMST theory is unadjusted Kaplan--Meier.

diaz2019improved: efficient covariate-adjusted RMST estimation in randomized trials under ordinary follow-up; the proposed endpoint tangent calculation is a narrow extension conditional on the new tail model.

cattaneo2024boundary gives boundary-local-polynomial control with nondegenerate information, while jiangdoksum2003local gives local hazard smoothing below the terminal support; neither supplies the stated collapsing-risk-set uniform result.
stute1995clt supplies endpoint integrability theory for Kaplan--Meier integrals; this explicit witness is a useful diagnostic consequence rather than an independent frontier advance.
westling2024inference supplies ordinary positive-follow-up Wald inference; this is principally an operational corollary of Theorem 1.

soundness_flags.label: ass:quadratic-censoring-endpoint
soundness_flags.one_line: The exact conditional law G_a(t|x)=(1-t)^2g_a(t,x) over the full horizon is load-bearing but the one-sentence appeal to a known administrative horizon does not establish that this no-atom, precisely quadratic depletion is realistic; ordinary administrative censoring instead commonly retains mass at the horizon.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the exact quadratic factorization by a clinically/design-justified tail-comparability class, such as c(1-t)^2<=G_a(t|x)<=C(1-t)^2 with stated smoothness for an estimable residual, and rederive the learner and drift bounds without oracle knowledge of the full censoring law.

Document a concrete follow-up/censoring mechanism that produces the proposed terminal tail, or retarget the paper explicitly to a designed depletion regime; otherwise the tail assumption reads as instrumental rather than scientifically motivated.

Add a boundary result contrasting the quadratic regime with a nearby censoring exponent where the integrated score loses square integrability or feasible root-n inference fails, using a named endpoint comparator to make the regime opening sharper.

recommended_next_step: Revise the endpoint-tail assumption into a credible, independently motivated regime before advancing; the learned-nuisance endpoint concentration kernel otherwise remains a field-tier novel target.
